senses.sense_definition: A slender, medium-sized African wild cat with long legs, large ears, and a spotted coat.

examples.text: The <w>serval</w> leaped high into the tall grass to catch a rodent.

target_lang_translations.zh: 那只<w>薮猫</w>高高跃入茂密的长草丛中去抓一只啮齿动物。

examples.text: With its unusually long legs and keen ears, the <w>serval</w> is an efficient nocturnal hunter.

target_lang_translations.zh: 凭借格外修长的四肢和敏锐的双耳，<w>薮猫</w>成了高效的夜行性猎手。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 一种体型修长、中等大小的非洲野猫，四肢修长，耳朵大，身上有斑点。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 非洲中型野生猫科动物
